# Coverage.py producer fixtures

These files are small native `.coverage` databases generated by coverage.py,
not hand-authored SQLite. Each database records the same `workload.py` with
branch coverage enabled and relative filenames, so the extractor test can run
from any checkout path.

The producer environments used to create them were:

| File | Producer |
| --- | --- |
| `coverage-7.14.sqlite` | coverage.py 7.14.2 |
| `coverage-7.15.sqlite` | coverage.py 7.15.2 |
| `coverage-7.13.sqlite` | coverage.py 7.13.4 (unsupported producer fixture) |

The committed fixture digests are:

```text
coverage-7.13.sqlite  sha256:a0abaa9526a9e98282244f4992a72379f6a5030f81b9ef8f9ea751160c0bf443
coverage-7.14.sqlite  sha256:f7e474c072f8689f976d34ba548af2b33372742aeec69846efee2b5f2046888d
coverage-7.15.sqlite  sha256:27b92be1194375c3249dbaab99f1dcf82d305dc5dc2f7ad1a1393681a2becbec
```

They were generated offline with the provider API from this directory:

```console
uv run --no-project --with coverage==7.14.2 python -c 'import runpy; import coverage; c=coverage.Coverage(data_file="coverage-7.14.sqlite", branch=True, config_file=False); c.set_option("run:relative_files", True); c.start(); runpy.run_path("workload.py", run_name="__main__"); c.stop(); c.save()'
uv run --no-project --with coverage==7.15.2 python -c 'import runpy; import coverage; c=coverage.Coverage(data_file="coverage-7.15.sqlite", branch=True, config_file=False); c.set_option("run:relative_files", True); c.start(); runpy.run_path("workload.py", run_name="__main__"); c.stop(); c.save()'
uv run --no-project --with coverage==7.13.4 python -c 'import runpy; import coverage; c=coverage.Coverage(data_file="coverage-7.13.sqlite", branch=True, config_file=False); c.set_option("run:relative_files", True); c.start(); runpy.run_path("workload.py", run_name="__main__"); c.stop(); c.save()'
```

The normal test suite only reads these immutable files through Flameox's
coverage.py reader; it does not install or select a provider version at
runtime.
